articles.title: Gold down 25% from peak of Rs 1.8 lakh; silver crashes nearly 60% in 10 months
articles.summary: Gold price crash: In the domestic market, MCX Gold is currently trading at Rs 1,34,884 per 10 grams down 0.4% so far this year and 25.4% or Rs 45,895 below its lifetime high of Rs 1.8 lakh.

articles.title: Petrol, diesel pump operators seek 30-40% hike in commissions, LPG dealers follow suit: Sources
articles.summary: Petrol, diesel and LPG dealers are seeking higher commissions due to rising operating costs, sources mentioned.

articles.title: IDBI Bank employees ask RBI to withhold approval of sale to Fairfax; call for strike on Dec 3

articles.title: 8th Pay Commission: Rail staff seek more time for talks; defence staff demand Rs 69,000 minimum pay
articles.summary: 8th Pay Commission news: In a letter dated November 12, 2026, AIRF secretary general Shiva Gopal Mishra sought a further two-day appointment with the commission to take up various employee-related issues.

articles.title: India's crude basket sees sharp shift in November as Brent share falls to 53.49%, Oman-Dubai gains
articles.summary: According to PPAC data released on November 17, Brent Dated's share declined by 11.78 percentage points in November, while Oman and Dubai's combined contribution increased by an equivalent margin.

articles.title: 2,194 gold hallmarking audits missed in five years: Who is checking the labs certifying your jewellery?
articles.summary: India's gold hallmarking system is facing scrutiny after the CAG's draft audit reportedly revealed that more than 43% of mandatory surveillance audits of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHCs) were not conducted over five years.

articles.summary: With Jimmy publicly siding against his own half-brother, the dispute is exposing deep cracks in the family that controls the Tata Group. Here’s a look at who Jimmy Tata is and why this clash matters now.

articles.title: Post-Diwali price hike shock loading: Daily essentials, phones, TVs, appliances to cost more
articles.summary: With the festive season now behind them, manufacturers are looking to recover the accumulated cost burden through higher retail prices and reductions in product grammage, potentially adding to the pressure on household budgets.

articles.summary: Although officially a senior director of product marketing for physical AI, Madison regularly attended her father’s quarterly meetings with his executive team, presented to the board and helped cultivate his public image.

articles.title: Tata Trusts row: Ratan Tata's brother Jimmy alleges 'back-door takeover', backs Chandrasekaran's third term
articles.summary: The ongoing power struggle within Tata Trusts has taken a fresh turn, with Ratan Tata’s younger brother Jimmy N Tata raising concerns over Noel Tata’s family gaining greater control.

articles.title: US reveals how Megaspeed came under scrutiny and landed on Nvidia's 'no sell' list
articles.summary: Nvidia has designated Singapore's Megaspeed as a 'no sell' entity in light of ongoing investigations surrounding semiconductor diversion. The US launched an inquiry in 2024, with a site visit occurring in June 2025.

articles.title: Meta tightens Instagram content recommendations in India amid govt scrutiny
articles.summary: Meta Platforms has recently modified Instagram's recommendation system in India, aiming to limit inappropriate content exposure. The changes come after the Indian government emphasized the need for careful content review and improved moderation.

articles.title: Rupee gains 31 paise to 93.63 against dollar as crude prices fall, FII inflows rise
articles.summary: On Tuesday, the Rupee appreciated to 93.63 against the US dollar, benefiting from declining crude oil prices and robust buying by foreign institutional investors (FIIs).

articles.title: Trump’s Nvidia stake grew to as much as $62 million: Report
articles.summary: Donald Trump's stake in Nvidia has escalated significantly, potentially reaching up to $62 million recently. Frequent trading of Nvidia shares by Trump's investment accounts has raised concerns over potential conflicts of interest.

articles.title: Is Noel Tata losing support within the Tata group? Here’s what we know
articles.summary: The most significant challenge has come from his half-brother Jimmy Naval Tata, who has backed a public listing of Tata Sons and Chandrasekaran’s continuation for a third term.

articles.title: Supreme Court approves ₹2,962 crore resolution plan for Videocon Group companies
articles.summary: The ruling affirms the appellate tribunal's power to order reconsideration amid objections over a 95% haircut.

articles.title: India faces 'acute' aircraft shortage, needs more than 1,000 planes: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: In an effort to address soaring air traffic demands, India plans to procure an extra 1,000 civilian aircraft. The government has underscored the importance of expedited delivery from credible manufacturers to increase the fleet size.

articles.title: Which are the top stocks to buy on November 17, 2026?
articles.summary: Stock market recommendations: Blue Star, UPL, Mankind Pharma, and Apollo Hospitals Enterprise have been identified by Somil Mehta, Head of Retail Research, Mirae Asset ShareKhan as the top stocks to buy today on November 17, 2026.

articles.summary: The department also requested statutory approval documents, project maps, and copies of permissions for tree-cutting at the site.

Quote of the Day by Deepinder Goyal: 'Don’t put processes around problem-solving; take as long as it takes to get to the right answer'
articles.summary: Deepinder Goyal is an Indian billionaire entrepreneur best known as the founder of Zomato, India's largest restaurant discovery and food delivery platform. He graduated from IIT Delhi in 2005 with an Integrated M.Tech in Mathematics and Computing.

articles.title: Oil prices fall as rising supply outweighs Middle East tensions
articles.summary: On Tuesday, oil prices dropped slightly as expectations of a global supply surplus gained traction. Analysts observed that geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are now having a diminished impact on pricing.

articles.title: Videocon insolvency likely to be delayed
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that the decision on the haircut for Twinstar Technologies' resolution plan rests with the Committee of Creditors. This ruling has led to further delays in the insolvency proceedings for the Videocon group, initiated in June 2018.

articles.title: Samsung, Xiaomi raise phone prices by up to Rs 4,000
articles.summary: In light of disappointing Diwali sales, Samsung and Xiaomi have announced a price increase on multiple smartphone models, effective November 16. The hikes range from Rs 1,000 to Rs 4,000, with Samsung's Galaxy A07 5G and Xiaomi's Redmi A7 seeing the most significant jumps.

articles.title: December car launches: New Fortuner, Honda ALPHA EV, JSW Combat, and the one you can actually buy
articles.summary: Five big car reveals are lined up for December, from the new Toyota Fortuner to Honda’s first EV. Only one, the VW Virtus facelift, has a confirmed India sale date. Here is the list.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 12% in October
articles.summary: Factory gate inflation based on the wholesale price index increased to 12.3% in October from 11.4% in September. This rise is attributed to the acceleration in fuel prices and a base effect.

articles.title: Govt to consider LTCG tax review demand: CBDT
articles.summary: Industry and market participants have been demanding that the long-term capital gains tax of 12.5% on listed equity shares be done away with to help boost the Indian stock markets.

articles.summary: Lakshmi and her mother, Mallika Srinivasan, argue a March 2024 MoU did not settle the economic interests through a formal valuation and mutually agreed division.

articles.title: Noel Tata at odds with more fellow trustees
articles.summary: Noel Tata is experiencing diminished influence within Tata Trusts due to rising opposition from fellow trustees and directors. His proposals concerning Tata Sons' listing and N Chandrasekaran's extended chairmanship fail to gain traction among key decision makers.
